newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-WESTERN AUSTRALIA THRASH QUEENSLAND IN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WESTERN AUSTRALIA THRASH QUEENSLAND IN FINAL.

text.p: A dashing half century by opener Ryan Campbell on Sunday helped Western Australia to an eight-wicket win over Queensland in the final of the Mercantile Mutual limited overs tournament.

Ryan's 50, scored off 45 deliveries and including seven fours and two sixes, saw Western Australia cruise to 149 for two with 15 overs to spare after they had dimissed Queensland for 148 in 40.1 overs.
Queensland's hopes of posting a competitive total evaporated when they lost their last eight wickets for 76.
